title: Add KMS latency/error dashboards + alert rules (per env/region)
author: Nadia Rahman
release_notes: Adds a KMS Dependency Health dashboard (latency/errors/throttling/circuit breaker) with per-environment and per-region views, plus recommended alert rules and runbook links for on-call triage.
description: Context: As part of the KMS integration hardening initiative we needed first-class dependency visibility for KMS across Hosted/Dedicated/Private paths. This PR adds a KMS Dependency Health dashboard and alert rules that align to the canonical error taxonomy (AccessDenied/NotFound/Throttling/Timeout/InvalidCiphertext/Unknown) and our metric namespacing conventions. Scope: (1) Dashboard: Overview + per env/region panels for request volume, latency (p50/p95/p99), error rate by category, throttling signals, and circuit breaker state; (2) Alerts: page-worthy vs ticket-worthy thresholds, with environment-aware routing (prod pages, staging tickets) and burn-rate style windows where appropriate; (3) Operator ergonomics: runbook links + log/trace pivot hints (trace_id, kms_key_id, provider, region, service); (4) Documentation: short README explaining how to use/tune the alerts and what to check first during an incident. Recommended thresholds (initial): Latency p95: warn >250ms for 10m, page >500ms for 5m (prod only); Timeout error rate: warn >0.25% for 10m, page >0.75% for 5m; Throttling: warn >0.5% for 10m, page >1.5% for 10m (with annotation to check retry storm/backpressure); AccessDenied: page on sustained >10/min for 5m (prod) because it often indicates mis-scoped IAM or a rollout regression; InvalidCiphertext: page on any sustained nonzero (>1/min for 5m) because it can indicate key mismatch/rotation cutover issues. Notes: thresholds are intentionally conservative and will be tuned post-rollout (see ENG-4828 follow-up and the alert noise discussion). This PR assumes the KMS metrics emitted by the runtime/control plane are available (redwood PR-18434 / PR-18515 / PR-18527) and uses the standardized tags: env, region, service, provider, error_category, error_code, kms_key_id (hashed).

alerts: add kms latency/error/throttle rules with env-aware routing
docs: add runbook links + dashboard usage notes
chore: align metric queries with final namespacing decision (kms_client.*)
review_conversation: Allison Grant (review): Panels look good. Two asks: (1) please split prod vs non-prod by default variable so on-call lands on prod first; (2) use the canonical error_category labels (AccessDenied, NotFound, Throttling, Timeout, InvalidCiphertext, Unknown) and avoid mixing raw provider codes in legend. Nadia Rahman (author): Done. Default env=prod, added an env_group variable (prod vs non-prod) + updated legends to error_category; raw codes are still available in a drilldown table. Sean Gallagher (review): Alert thresholds might be noisy in staging. Can we ensure only prod routes to paging and everything else to ticket/Slack? Also link the decrypt failures runbook. Nadia Rahman (author): Updated notification policy: prod pages, staging/dev create tickets + Slack only. Added runbook link placeholder now pointing to the KMS decrypt failures runbook page. Kevin Osei (review): For AccessDenied, can we add a note to check recent IAM module bumps and include principal/key ARN hints? Also prefer adding annotation labels for linked linear + runbook. Nadia Rahman (author): Added alert annotations with runbook_url + linear_key=ENG-4828; expanded the AccessDenied alert description to call out IAM policy/role separation changes and to check audit logs for principal/key arn mismatch. Rafael Mendes (review): Please add a panel for circuit breaker open state + request shed/backpressure if present; this was a gap in the last KMS timeout spike. Nadia Rahman (author): Added circuit breaker open gauge and a timeseries for kms_client.backpressure_dropped_requests_total where available (panel auto-hides if metric missing). Final: Allison approved after the env default + label cleanup; Logan also approved after confirming query costs are reasonable.
